text_block_list.text:
While walking through the park with Twin 
Turbo, we ran into K.S. Miracle and 
Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...We really can't find it after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Miracle! Zephyr! What are you two doing~?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hello, Turbo. I'm looking for 
Zephyr's charm.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's an amulet with a soft color, 
resembling white sand, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It was nowhere in plain sight... Could a 
capricious gust of wind have swept it away 
and carried it into the hedge...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, perhaps there are times 
when it is necessary to simply let the ill 
winds blow past.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"The hedge? Could it be hidden inside the 
hedge?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then Turbo will go find it for you! 
Toryaaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Uh—

Twin Turbo dashed off at full speed and 
dove headfirst into a hedge before anyone 
could stop her!

I called out to them, but there was no 
response...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Could they be injured...? I'll go look 
for them!"

—It happened just as K.S.Miracle made her 
move.
(—Skiiiiddddddd!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!! I'm hoooome~!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...! It's just like a little 
snowball tumbling in the winter wind.

Twin Turbo returned covered in mud, but— 
she herself didn't seem any different than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, were you worried about me? I'm 
totally fine, really!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Besides, we found a bunch of stuff!
Twin Turbo hopped up and down on the spot—

All sorts of things came tumbling out from 
the gaps in her clothes and hair! Feng 
shui tools, a flashy hand mirror, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —! There it is, my charm...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy for you, Zephyr. Though, 
really... hehe!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Turbo sure is full of energy! Looks like a 
bunch of other lost items were found too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Running so freely and boundless, 
it feels as refreshing as a sudden gust of 
wind.
choice_data_list:
I'm worried, so please let me know before 
you act...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Running so freely and boundless, 
it feels as refreshing as a sudden gust of 
wind.
choice_data_list:
I'm worried, so please let me know before 
you act...!

text_block_list.text:
Her drive to take action is extraordinary. 
Despite my worries, I couldn't help but 
admire it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem!! Right?! Turbo's amazing, isn't 
she?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
From now on, leave all lost items to 
Turbo! I'll search anywhere and everywhere 
for ya~♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Anywhere? That is... hehe, I won't be able 
to take my eyes off you, then.

I'm glad we found what Yamanin Zephyr 
lost, but it certainly gave me quite a 
scare.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Worried? Trainer, were you worried about 
Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, got it♪ Then I'll make sure to hit 
you up from now on!
